style.styleTitle: Personalised Christmas Wreath Wooden House Ornament by PMC
style.toneOfVoice: Add a warm and festive touch to your home with this Personalised Christmas Wreath Wooden House Ornament. Featuring a charming wreath design, this beautifully crafted wooden decoration can be personalised with 5 lines of custom text (2 lines of up to 12 characters each and 3 lines of up to 20 characters each), making it a thoughtful Christmas gift or treasured keepsake. Perfect for hanging on the tree, styling shelves or adding to seasonal displays, this personalised ornament brings a cosy, traditional and festive feel to any home décor. Dimensions(mm): Height: 140 Width: 183 Depth: 25.
